name: Cathay Pacific Airways Limited
via: Swire Pacific is Cathay Pacific's largest shareholder, owning approximately 43.09% of the issued ordinary shares as at 31 December 2025 (Annual Report 2025)
note: The Cathay brand's airline, listed in Hong Kong (00293). Other substantial shareholders: Air China (effective interest 29.98% per Air China's interim report 2025) and, until the company's February 2026 share buy-back, Qatar Airways (9.57% at 31 December 2025, Annual Report 2025).
